SUMMARY: All 609 BGC rows are linked to MIBiG accessions
1,095 eligible Phase-1 TERM rows remained at the time this copy was created
README: 609 fungal biosynthetic gene-cluster dossiers, each linked to a MIBiG accession.

Separate tables contain BGCs, organisms, strains, facets, genes, metabolites, experiments, experimental terms, measurements, observations, claims, relationships, conflicts, sources and evidence links.
SOURCE and EVIDENCE_LINK contain literature and database provenance.
RAW_ROW retains non-empty biological source rows.
TERM contains raw and canonical term labels; NORMALIZATION_QUEUE contains mappings that remain unresolved.
Explicit missingness and uncertainty states are retained where present.
Static shareable copy created 21 August 2026. The working normalization file remains separate.
